mechanics.claim: Charm slows the target by 65% in addition to charming them.
Charm can slow targets even if they are immune to slows.
mechanics.quote: ''Charm'' is able to {{tip|slow}} targets otherwise {{tip|slow immunity|immune to slows}} upon {{tip|charm|charming}} them.

mechanics.claim: This ability's damage uses the caster's stats at the time the cast completes, not when it hits.
mechanics.quote: This ability's damage is calculated based on the caster's stats at the time of its application.

mechanics.claim: Charm hits only the first enemy hit by the projectile, dealing magic damage and knocking them down.
mechanics.quote: deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit, {{tip|knockdown|knocking them down}}
